title: Compact snapshot and scenario scripts for exec sparring
creator: Lena Cho
description: Prepare a compact, single-sheet snapshot and a set of scenario-driven Q&A scripts for exec sparring ahead of the Q2 roadmap readout. The deliverables are: 1) a one-page snapshot that summarizes initiative health, risks, and ask lanes; 2) a prioritized list of 8–12 likely exec questions with suggested concise responses and data references; 3) an operational trigger/runbook for escalation lanes (cost, latency, regression); and 4) a rehearsal schedule with observers and success criteria. This ticket coordinates PM, design, and eng to create the artifacts, run two rehearsals (dry run + exec sparring), and hand off an action tracker for follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: One-page snapshot exported to Confluence (final version) with data links and one-line asks
Question/answer script of 10-12 prioritized questions documented and annotated with supporting charts/URLs
Escalation runbook with owners, SLAs, and fallback model mapping created and reviewed by Eng leads
Two rehearsals completed: internal dry run (PM+Design+Eng) and exec sparring (with 1 exec or exec proxy); notes captured
Action tracker created in Linear and linked to the Confluence packet; owners assigned for all follow-ups
Slides and snapshot uploaded to the board-readout deck PR and a review PR created in GitHub
